items.result: Mixed, promising: ×0.1 cuts violations to 107 at no cost; ×0.25 reaches 73 unrouted but loses a clean board.

items.title: Grid → maze, first version

items.title: Grid → maze (GPU grid first)
items.result: Neutral on the corpus (21/42, 83 unrouted, 117 violations), a win on dense boards; 3.3× the time.
